feat(post): add Hurco WinMax (NC) ISNC post and Hurco VM10i machine

Add clean-room Hurco WinMax (NC) ISNC 3-axis mill post
(assets/posts/hurco-winmax.cps) and Hurco VM10i machine definition
(assets/machines/hurco-vm10i.mch), register both in posting_files, add
post/app pinning tests and goldens, and check every golden against the
documented WinMax ISNC word set.

Stacked on #2506.

Fixes #2573

fix(post): correct WinMax probe status and offset registers

Check each touch and guard with the documented skip status. Read the active source offset from the WinMax axis register ranges. Pin both behaviors and retain the pending simulator requirement.

Refs #2573

fix(post): seat WinMax cycles at the section hop

Cancel active cycles before movement between holes. Pin safe seating and missing-hop refusal after cycles, probing, feeds, and arcs. Use the required Camcraft vendor value.

Keep simulator acceptance pending.

Refs #2573

fix(post): Hurco WinMax writes no G43 H by default; M140/M126 opt-in

The tester's WinMax simulator stopped at G43 H562. Hurco's online help
(Tool and Radius Offsets) says that with no G43/G44 and no H word, the
control takes the tool length from the Tool Setup screen, and that the
H register range is H00..H200.

- Default output writes no G43 H line after T M6.
- toolLengthOffset (default off) writes G43 H<tool>; a tool outside
  1..200 is refused by name.
- retractAlongToolVector (default off) writes G00 M140 at the end of
  each operation; the next X/Y traverse states its Z first.
- shortestRotaryPath (default off) writes M126 at start, M127 before M30.
- Tool pre-fetch is deferred to #4113.
- Hurco goldens regenerated; merge fallout fixed in the Hurco tests
  (ProgramId.notes, OpParams picks/blend_radius/chain_overrides,
  corner_relief, pass_start).

Fixes #2573

fix(post): Hurco WinMax posts no arc block for a sub-step arc

Main's #3442 law (radius_arcs: major_arcs_use_negative_r_and_degenerate_
arcs_fall_back_to_ijk) now reaches this post through the merge. An inch
arc of r=0.001 mm wrote `G03 X0. Y0. I0. J0.`, which a control reads as
a full circle. onCircular now asks arcFate (PRELUDE) first, as the other
shipped posts do, with arcIncOf(fu) for the incremental I J K.
